title: Your New Home Has a $90K Bill Nobody Warned You About
hook: You calculated the mortgage, the taxes, the insurance — but there's one bill missing from every first-time buyer's spreadsheet, and it adds up to $90,000.
angle: Exposes the 1% maintenance rule that almost every home-buying guide ignores — showing the exact compounding cost of skipping it over a 20-year ownership window
audience: First-time homebuyers, current homeowners, and renters deciding whether to buy
key_numbers: 1% of home value per year for maintenance
64% of homeowners say they were blindsided by repair costs
